Image compressor with target size in KB

Many websites reject files above a size limit. Instead of guessing the quality setting, enter a Target max size and BG Studio tests several quality levels and keeps the highest one that stays under your limit.

How to compress an image to a specific size

  1. Add your image.
  2. Under Format & compression, choose JPEG (accepted almost everywhere) or WebP.
  3. Type your limit in Target max size (KB), for example 100.
  4. Click Convert & download. The result line shows the final size and the quality that was used.

If the file is still too big

  • Reduce Width & height. Fewer pixels shrink a file far more than lower quality does.
  • JPEG and WebP can hit a size target; PNG cannot because it is lossless.
  • Photos compress much better than screenshots with sharp text.

Frequently asked questions

How does the target size work?

The tool tries several quality levels and picks the highest one that produces a file at or below your limit.

Will compression ruin my image?

Lossy formats discard tiny details. At around 70–85% quality most photos still look sharp.

What is the largest image I can load?

Up to 25 MB, 16,384 px per side and 40 megapixels.

Are my photos uploaded?

No. Compression happens in your browser, so your files stay on your device.
